title: Cream of Brie Soup
description: This creamy soup with Brie cheese is a rich and delicious treat, whether you choose to ladle it into a regular soup bowl or a warm, toasted bread bowl.
ingredients: 0.5 pound Brie cheese with the rind, cubed
1 tablespoon green bell pepper, cut into very fine matchsticks
1 tablespoon red bell pepper, cut into very fine matchsticks

steps.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and celery; cook until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in flour and cook for 3 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in chicken stock. Simmer until celery is tender, about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in Brie cheese and allow to melt for about 5 minutes.

Pour soup into a blender, filling the pitcher no more than halfway full. Hold down the lid of the blender with a folded kitchen towel, then carefully start the blender, using a few quick pulses to get the soup moving before leaving it on to purée. Purée in batches until smooth. Pour into a clean pot. Heat soup to almost simmering over medium-low heat. Pour in cream. To serve, garnish with red and green pepper strips.

video.description: A fluffy, soft, and flaky delight to have with breakfast. Spread on jam, butter, honey, (or all three!) for a tasty addition to many meals.
